title_as_printed: Experimental and calculated water content for CO2 in equilibrium with a hydrate phase.

footnotes_as_printed.a: Uncertainty from temperature measurements was calculated to be +-0.1K.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Uncertainty for pressure measurements calculated to be +-0.001 MPa.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Uncertainty for water content measurements was calculated to be +-20 ppm.

pressure_note: p / MPa listed with footnote a (printed text of a refers to temperature uncertainty, b to pressure; letters appear swapped); thesis does not state total vs partial; single-phase CO2-rich fluid (CO2 liquid at these p) in equilibrium with hydrate, so p is the cell (total) pressure by context.

composition.other_species: pure CO2 (liquid CO2-rich phase) + hydrate; no salt

extra_unmapped: yH2O(calc) / ppm (model calculation by the author, not measured)
volume_basis_evidence: quantity labelled yH2O (mole fraction) in ppm; instrument (TDLAS) readings are called ppmv in the text; paper does not state whether ppm is mole or volume basis
notes: Blank-line separated isotherm blocks (238, 244, 248, 253, 258, 263, 268, 273, 278 K nominal; 6 rows each) are not marked by label rows. Rows below 273.15 K are below the ice point and in the hydrate region. T drifts within some blocks (e.g. 244.58 -> 241.80 K in the 244 K block; 263.20 -> 262.22 K). T printed with 2 decimals.
